exit: 0
--- stdout
Print the text-form vocabulary, the unit scale factors and every code oce reports

Usage: oce vocab [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json             Print the JSON report instead of text
      --render <RENDER>  When to write a human-readable rendering of the report to stderr [default: auto] [possible values: auto, always, never]
  -h, --help             Print help
  -V, --version          Print version
